name: Tiny Desk AI
tagline: Turn photos into a Tiny Desk-style concert parody video
description: Tiny Desk AI is an independent photo-to-video tool for creating short concert parody clips. It supports a solo portrait or a five-person group photo and produces a 15-second vertical video with synchronized sound. Video generation uses one-time credit packs starting at $9.99. The project is not affiliated with NPR or Tiny Desk Concerts.
